considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a wide concrete driveway that leads from the street directly to the front of the residence and garage, with space for vehicle staging. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. The rear yard is fenced and contains a lawn and patio area. Paved walkways are also observed on either side of the house, connecting the front with the back part of the property. Neighboring homes are close on multiple sides in this residential subdivision. Overall street access is straightforward, with good visibility of the front of the structure.
